module: Generates the fuel prices of the level's gas stations and displays them on the scene's 7-segment display signs. When the level starts, for each station that has `prices`, computes a price (base + randomness) and replaces the display objects with TSStatic copies of the digits (`art/shapes/quarter_mile_display/display_<c>.dae`). Unloads itself if there is no price data. Global: freeroam_facilities_fuelPrice.
notes: Price = priceBaseline + priceRandomnessGain * (random() - priceRandomnessBias) when gain and bias are provided. A `disabled` fuel shows "-" on the displays.

getFuelPrice always returns the metric price (per liter); for display, if the level's local unit (localUnits) is gallonUS, the price is multiplied by 3.78541. The price is formatted "%.3f" without the dot; us_9_10_tax forces the 4th digit to 9.
The original display objects are hidden; the copies are in the `fuelPrice_localCopies` SimGroup (not saved).
restoreSign(hide) deletes the copies and puts the original shapes back (display_8.dae); calls pairs(cachedPriceData) without a nil test, so errors if the prices were never generated.
In _set7CharDisplay, the digit is composed with the character from the price string; if an object is not found, the error is logged (tag setPrices).

onSerialize.desc: Called before a Lua reload: saves cachedPriceData, the current level and the local unit.

onDeserialized.desc: Called after a Lua reload: restores the prices if in the same level, otherwise regenerates the prices (onClientStartMission).

onClientStartMission.desc: Hook at level start: calls setDisplayPrices; if there is no price data, unloads the extension.

setDisplayPrices.desc: Computes the prices of all the stations of the current level and updates the displays.

returns.desc: true if at least one price was generated.

getFuelPrice.desc: Current price (metric unit) of a fuel at a station.

restoreSign.desc: Deletes the digit copies and restores the original signs (display 8), optionally hidden. Useful before moving a sign in the editor.
